Estimates vs Consensus

Our 1Q17 and 2Q17 revenue and EBITDA estimates are ahead above the Street. We assume ~800bps of advertising growth deceleration in 3Q and another ~400bps in 4Q, and our 2017 estimates are also slightly above consensus. On that premise, we are comfortable that Street estimates sufficiently reflect potential impact of News Feed ad
load deceleration in 2H17.
